overview.label: Official name
overview.value: National University of Computer & Emerging Sciences (FAST-NUCES)

overview.label: Overview
overview.value: Federally chartered (Ordinance No. XXIII of 2000) multi-campus private-sector university; campuses in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Peshawar and Chiniot-Faisalabad.

overview.label: HEC recognition
overview.value: Listed on HEC university profiles; Karachi campus on HEC Recognized Campuses list (checked 2026-10-10/11).

programs.label: Other UG at Karachi
programs.value: BS Electrical Engineering, BS Business Analytics, BS FinTech listed on Karachi homepage (2026-10-10); BBA/BS A&F listed university-wide.
programs.note: Karachi-specific availability of business programmes not re-confirmed on 2026-10-13.

admissions.label: Eligibility (BS Computing)
admissions.value: SSC 60% minimum; HSSC 50% minimum; Mathematics required at HSSC. Pre-Medical students who passed additional Mathematics are eligible.

admissions.label: Merit formula (BS Computing)
admissions.value: Admission test 50% + HSSC 40% + SSC 10%

admissions.label: Admission test options
admissions.value: One of: FAST-NUCES admission test, SAT, or NTS NAT-IE / NAT-ICS

admissions.label: Test pattern (computing)
admissions.value: Advanced Maths 50%, Analytical/IQ 20%, Essay 20%, English 10%; negative marking

admissions.label: Latest schedule (2026 intake, tentative)
admissions.value: Applications 20 May - 30 Jun 2026; tests 29 Jun - 10 Jul 2026; merit list 22 Jul 2026; classes 17 Aug 2026

admissions.label: Fall 2027 deadlines
admissions.note: Schedule page (updated 13-Oct-2026) still shows the 2026 tentative schedule.

fees.label: Hostel fee
fees.note: No Karachi hostel listed by NU.

scholarships.label: Merit scholarship
scholarships.value: Top three board position holders and top three on each campus admission merit list; full tuition; continuation requires semester GPA >= 3.0

scholarships.label: Interest-free study loan
scholarships.value: For bright indigent students; repay within 4 years after graduation

scholarships.label: Sindh Government Endowment Board
scholarships.value: Need-cum-merit, full tuition, renewable yearly (60% rural / 40% urban quota)

scholarships.label: External / alumni aid
scholarships.value: PM National ICT scholarships (Ignite), BEEF, PEEF, OSAF, FANA, Ihsan Trust, community scholarships

facilities.label: Hostel
facilities.value: No in-campus hostel at Karachi: NU FAQ lists hostels only at Chiniot-Faisalabad, Multan and Peshawar.

facilities.label: Transport
facilities.value: Transport facility available at all campuses (NU FAQ).

facilities.label: Campus hours / parking
facilities.value: Main Campus 8am-4pm, five days; City Campus (PECHS) open till 9pm, six days; parking at both.

facilities.label: Library / labs / sports
facilities.note: Not itemised on Karachi pages read.
